name: power_plant_river_carnot
title: 1 GW power plant cooled by river water (exercise 6.22)
summary: Teaching exercise for a 1 GW power plant that rejects heat to river water. The condensation pressure fixes the low temperature of an equivalent Carnot cycle, and the model returns the Carnot efficiency, the condenser heat rate and the river temperature rise.

origin.course: ULiège, thermodynamique appliquée, THD09, R04, exercise 6.22 (2009)
